description: Status of the brand's Deep AI Dive run. Free read. operationStatus.status is pending | processing | completed | failed; while processing, progress = {current, total} landed (engine, market) slots plus a plain-language message. A brand with nothing running (never ran, or finished long ago) reads as failed with an error starting 'No check' — that means idle, not broken. Any other failed error is a real failure. Poll every ~15-30s; a run usually takes a few minutes and is considered failed after 3 hours. When completed, read the results with search_ai_visibility.
name: ai_visibility_run_status
